tex_content.html: egin{example} \end{example}[Exercise: the $L^p$ energy inequality] 1. ch12:12.27\group Heat Equation Uniqueness ↗ thm:lp-heat-subsolution-vanishing Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0184 The energy inequality in the proof of Theorem 1.4 follows from \[ -4\int _Mu^{p/2}\varphi _r\langle abla \varphi _r, abla u^{p/2} angle \leq rac{2(p-1)}p\int _M\varphi _r^2| abla u^{p/2}|^2 + rac{2p}{p-1}\int _Mu^p| abla \varphi _r|^2. \] \end{example}
